title: C29 active candidate was omitted from the tracked distribution inventory

reproduction.error: root dist count 48 does not match 47
reproduction.observed: The current control-plane tree tracked 48 root archives while .mir/distributions.json typed only the 47 published archives.

root_cause.summary: Freezing C29 correctly committed the deterministic active candidate to dist, but the same freeze did not add a non-release row to the complete tracked-root distribution inventory. The fresh v5 C24 calibration therefore rejected the current release-history authority before any runtime work began.

regression_propositions: every tracked root distribution has exactly one .mir/distributions.json row
the C29 row binds its exact frozen archive bytes and package-source commit
the C29 row remains explicitly non-release until governed promotion and tagging
superseded candidates remain absent from the root distribution inventory

closure.proof_required: release-history integrity and complete fresh C24 calibration under a new immutable context
